page.layout: One column of running text with a centred heading ("CONCIO.") in its middle. No margin notes. Running head at the top right. Catchword at the lower right. Page number at the top left. Fragments at the far right edge belong to the neighbouring page and are left out.

main_text.p: ut pecunia pacem emerent, Mcbode[?] fatrapa ad du-cem ablegato. Venit ergò ad Romanos Mebodes, Persa, ac Imperator exercitus concione coacta, ad ipsum audiendum, ordinem ductores, ac tribunos, & auxiliares, reliquosque inter milites illustriores convocat, qua colleƈta concione, Persa in hæc ver-ba orsus est:
main_text.head: CONCIO.
main_text.p: Viri bellicosi, ne vero vos percutiat audientes hoc Legati procemium. Si enim sententias muta-veritis, mutabo & ego denunciationem: Excolite pacem deposito bello, hastæque & gladius ut antiquata valeant, & pro militia capite sistulam lene simul & pastorale canentem melos; Persarum rex amans pacis est, cultu ornatur aptiore, non ornamentis bellicis. Regia enim est pacis placiditas, sicuti tyrannorum propria Discordia. Viri qui estis eodem modo nobiscum affecti, relinquatur bellum solum omnibus rebus inexplebile. Sanguine terram polluimus, sæpè mortem vidimus, mortem cuius pictor est bellum, ego vero dico etiam archetypum, & humanorum malorum autor & magister per se & naturâ suâ. Pecuniam amat aliquis, sed opibus & paupertate ludimur, aliquando victi, vincentes aliquando, & iaƈtati simul cum belli fortuna ancipiti, perpetuam quasi volutationem patimur. Superbit alius auro principum, cum volu-ptate possidet perfidiam, quid enim in bello magis est perfidum pecunia? absq; discrimine defertur ab illo ad alium, & ab alio rursus ad alium, quasi si evi-gilans somnium, quod somnia veris, videas, aut die

page.notes: The page number "90" at the top left is partly faint and read as 90 [?]. Doubtful readings: "Mcbode" (the same name appears as "Mebodes" later in the line, so the first letter may be an e) and "evi-" (printed "eui-", corrected to the consonant v). Long s is written as plain s. The small mark at the bottom left is a gathering signature that cannot be read and is left out. The fragments at the right edge are the neighbouring page and are not transcribed.
